 Following its successful theatrical run, Curry Barker’s Hollywood thriller  Obsession is set to make its OTT debut with a Hindi-dubbed version featuring Bollywood stars Kriti Sanon and Varun Dhawan as voice artists. 
 The film, led by  Inde Navarrette and Michael Johnston, will stream in both Hindi and English on The Peacock Hub via JioHotstar.

 When Will Obsession Premiere On OTT? 
 The uncut versions of Obsession will premiere on October 30 at 7 pm, giving Indian audiences an opportunity to experience the thriller in Hindi as well as its original English version.  Kriti has voiced Nikki, while Varun has lent his voice to Bear, bringing a distinctly Indian touch to the film’s digital release. 
 © Jio Hotstar 
 Sharing the teaser, Jio Hotstar wrote, "We wished we could tell you sooner, but where’s the fun in that? Kriti Sanon and Varun Dhawan, with Amar Kaushik, have been cooking up something we're just a little obsessed with. Obsession: The Original Uncut Version streams 30th October, 7 PM onwards, exclusively on The Peacock Hub on JioHotstar."

 What Did Kriti & Varun Say About Obsession's Hindi Dub? 
 In an official statement, Kriti spoke about her experience watching Barker’s directorial venture, describing it as a gripping, quirky and twisted story. She also revealed that Nikki was unlike the characters she had explored previously, making the dubbing experience both exciting and challenging for her. 
 For Kriti Sanon, Obsession marks her first experience of lending her voice to another actor's on-screen performance. The actress said she could not have chosen a more exciting project for her dubbing debut, adding that she thoroughly enjoyed the process and was looking forward to audiences discovering the film in Hindi. 
 © Jio Hotstar 
 Varun Dhawan, meanwhile, said working on the Hindi adaptation allowed him to revisit the thriller from a fresh perspective. Listening closely to the performances and revisiting the story helped him notice details he might have overlooked while watching it for the first time. 
 "I noticed so many little details that I may have missed on a first watch, and that made the whole experience even more interesting. I’m excited for audiences to experience Obsession in Hindi and discover those details for themselves," he said. 
 About Obsession 
 Curry Barker’s Obsession, starring Inde Navarrette and Michael Johnston, follows a man whose wish to win his crush’s heart unleashes terrifying consequences. The horror thriller became a global box-office hit, earning over $500 million worldwide.
